children: Southern Cross Acquisition II completed an IPO raising $76.53 million and placed $76.72 million in a trust account.
Consummated IPO of 7,652,630 units at $10.00 each, including partial 152,630 over-allotment exercise, raising $76,526,300 gross.
Completed concurrent private placement of 224,932 units to Sponsor and underwriter reps for $2,249,320 gross.
Placed $76,717,616 in a trust account for public shareholders and underwriters (net of expenses and working capital).
Auditor issued an unqualified opinion but notes substantial doubt about ability to continue as a going concern due to limited operating history and 12-month business combination deadline.
Balance sheet shows $660,417 cash, $76,717,616 cash in trust; total assets $77,441,783 and working capital $374,839.
